Persija vs PSM: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the Indonesia Super League continues to heat up, the highly anticipated match between Persija Jakarta and PSM Makassar promises to be a thrilling encounter. Both teams are vying for crucial points as they aim to secure their positions in the league standings. With a rich history and fierce rivalry, this clash is particularly significant for both sets of supporters. Fans can expect an intense battle as Persija looks to leverage home advantage against a determined PSM side. Kick-off: 20.02.2026, 13:30 UTC / 16:30 MSK
Stadium: Gelora Bung Karno Stadium
Competition: Indonesia - Super League

Match Preview

Persija Jakarta enters this match after a series of mixed results, sitting mid-table and looking to build momentum heading into the final stretch of the season. Manager Thomas Doll has been instilling confidence in his players, but inconsistency has plagued the team, making every match a crucial opportunity to reclaim form. PSM Makassar, on the other hand, will come into this fixture with a solid run lately, displaying a resilience that has taken them near the top of the league standings. Under the guidance of coach Bernardo Tavares, they will look to exploit any defensive lapses from Persija. Injuries will play a significant role, with both teams hoping to have their key players available. Persija’s star forward, Marko Simic, is reportedly back in training after a brief injury layoff, while PSM’s attacking duo are in good shape, adding to the competitive nature of this derby. Fans can anticipate a charged atmosphere as the two clubs aim to assert their dominance early in the match.

Team Form and Analysis

Persija

Persija’s defensive structure has been somewhat shaky this season, often leaving gaps for opposing teams to exploit. However, their attack has shown flashes of brilliance, particularly when utilizing the speed and skill of their wingers. If Simic returns, he will undoubtedly play a vital role in leading the line. With a few key players returning from injury, Persija will hope to find their rhythm and capitalize on home advantage to secure a vital three points.

PSM

PSM Makassar has built a strong reputation for their disciplined defense, having recorded several clean sheets this season. Their tactics generally involve a compact midfield that transitions swiftly into counter-attacks. Key players like Mochammad Supriadi bring pace and skill down the flanks, and if they can find the net early, it may change the course of the game. The team will be eager to demonstrate their credentials against a traditional rival in this important match.

Predicted Starting Lineups

  • Persija:
    • Goalkeeper: Andritany Ardhiyasa

However, injuries to key defenders have raised concerns over their stability at the back. Hamburger SV
